notes.title: Metamorphos Achievements & Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Enjoying Metamorphos?  Then we have some exciting news for you!  An update to the game has just been made that gives the game [b]8 brand new achievements[/b] for you to hunt down!  Not only does the game now feature these new achievements, but we also have a host of patch notes to share:

[list]
[*]Added a save system.
[*]Final boss has been tuned to be even more enjoyable.
[*]Fixed game-breaking bug where the final boss's animations would lock up.
[*]Various bugs have been fixed.
[*]Fixed an issue with in-game music.
[*]Fixed a small typo.
[/list]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1592260/Metamorphos/]Click here to download for free now![/url]

notes.title: OMFG: One Million Fatal Guns technically has over 30 million
notes.notes:
Borderlands pulled the "we've got millions of guns" trick over a decade ago, but OMFG: One Million Fatal Guns does it again only with sillier, more over-the-top results. I'm talking guns that fire spiders, guns that fire words, guns that turn out the lights, and guns that do all three at the same time while propelling you backwards like a jetpack.

Despite the variety, it's a slight game - but hey, it's also free.
